subject.title: Incomplete turn with tool call and payloads=0 is replayUnsafe and may poison session state

question: For stopReason=stop, tools>0, payloads=0, replaySafe=no turns, should OpenClaw keep the current fail-closed behavior, retry/fallback when current-attempt side effects are proven absent, or always quarantine and require a fresh session boundary?
rationale: The source path is clear, but deciding when a replay-unsafe tool attempt may be retried or summarized is a product and safety boundary that can duplicate side effects if chosen incorrectly.

options.title: Allow Proven Current-Attempt Recovery
options.body: Add a narrow current-attempt safety signal so empty turns with no executed side effects can consume retry/fallback budgets while true side-effecting attempts remain fail-closed.

options.title: Keep Fail-Closed With Better Quarantine
options.body: Preserve no-retry behavior for replaySafe=no turns but persist a durable quarantine/repair marker and make later prompt construction skip or summarize the malformed branch.

options.title: Leave Current Behavior
options.body: Accept that replaySafe=no post-tool empty turns surface an error and rely on model/config workarounds rather than expanding recovery semantics.

recommendation.title: Allow Proven Current-Attempt Recovery
recommendation.body: Add a narrow current-attempt safety signal so empty turns with no executed side effects can consume retry/fallback budgets while true side-effecting attempts remain fail-closed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release and replay/fallback history makes this the best available routing candidate for the policy choice.
